description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RecipeInputFormTrait' that provides helper methods for building, validating, and setting input forms for recipes within the Drupal framework. It includes methods for generating form trees, validating user input, and supplying input data to recipes, utilizing Drupal's form and typed data APIs.

classes.name: RecipeInputFormTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing helper methods for form handling related to recipes, including form building, validation, and input setting.

methods.name: buildRecipeInputForm
methods.description: Generates a nested form array of input elements for a given recipe, grouped by recipe and dependencies, with '#tree' set to TRUE.

methods.name: validateRecipeInput
methods.description: Validates user input for a recipe, setting errors in the form state if validation fails.

methods.name: setRecipeInput
methods.description: Assigns user input values from the form state to the recipe's input data.
